verdict.rationale: Brex documents multi-level approval flows for bill pay that route automatically by amount, vendor and employee role. Its expense rules also let admins define who needs to approve, so the core multi-step chain exists. Delegation and time-based escalation of stalled approvals are not evidenced. The review agent's 'escalates exceptions' covers policy exceptions, not approvers who sit on requests. Missing for 10: approver delegation/out-of-office reassignment, escalation when approvers don't act, explicit manager/budget-owner/finance chain roles, multi-step chains for card expenses beyond bill pay, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can build multi-step approval chains — manager, budget owner, finance — with delegation and escalation when approvers sit on requests

citations.quote: Tailor multi-level approval flows based on amount, vendor, employee role, and more — and Brex will route for you automatically to ensure the right people sign off every time.
Set rules for how employees can spend, what they need to document, and who needs to approve.
Eliminate data entry, automate approvals, and spin up virtual cards in one click to maximize your rewards.
